Hi Sam / Alicia,

Great — we'd love to run the walkthrough. A quick note on timezones: our core demo engineers are based in Central Europe (CET) and typically avoid very early mornings, so we tend to propose late afternoon CET slots which map to morning US times. Also FYI the US switches to Daylight Saving Time on Mar 8, which will shift US local clocks an hour forward (EU switches later in March). To avoid confusion, it's helpful to lock to UTC when we confirm.

Two options that work for our EU team (all times listed as local + UTC):

- Option A: Wed, Mar 10 — 16:00–17:00 CET (15:00–16:00 UTC) — this will be 08:00–09:00 PDT for you (note: US will already be on DST by then).
- Option B: Thu, Mar 11 — 14:00–15:00 CET (13:00–14:00 UTC) — this will be 06:00–07:00 PDT.

If those are too early on your side, we can instead offer Tue Mar 9 at 18:00–19:00 CET (17:00–18:00 UTC) which is 09:00–10:00 PST (before the DST change).

I've attached a short cheat-sheet that shows the conversions; Alex is cc'd to help with calendar logistics. If you confirm Option A (Mar 10 15:00 UTC) I'll drop a calendar invite with dial-in details.

Best,
